_why: Retrofitted 2026-07-28 after the campaign twice claimed a wave complete when it was not.
The prose plan cannot answer 'is this wave done?' — this file can, via scripts/wave-status.sh.
Items with no `issue` are recorded as 'informal': work done directly off the plan with no
issues/NNN-*.md behind it. That is exactly the gap that made false completion claims cheap,
so wave-status.sh treats an informal item marked done as a violation unless `note` justifies it.
Not backfilling issue files retroactively for already-shipped Wave 0 items: they are landed and
verified, and inventing DoDs after the fact would be documentation theatre. New work gets a real
issue file first — see docs/agents/staff-engineer-agent.md Mode E.

G3.title: Source discovery — prove the chain end to end
G3.note: CLOSED and PROVEN end to end 2026-07-29 through the PRIMARY path. Direct BraveClient.search/2 on the live node -> BRAVE_OK results=3 (real SA bookshops); full SourceDiscoveryJob run -> discovered_sources 5->15 with NO fallback warning. Was never a missing key (it was in .env and Deployed all along) — two real bugs: (1) the daily counter crashed on the first live call in any fresh node via a lying default; (2) the client advertised Accept-Encoding: gzip and never decompressed, so EVERY Brave 200 failed to parse and SearXNG silently covered for it. G6.title: Business opt-out — form, soft-delete, review queue
G6.note: CLOSED and DRIVEN END TO END 2026-07-29 on a clean preview. #303 built (admin-session API, sign-in gate with inline MFA enrolment, in-memory admin token, all four pages repointed). XHR trace proves the whole chain: admin/auth/login 200 -> verify_mfa 200 -> GET /api/admin/sources 200 -> PUT .../approve 200 (row Pending_review -> Approved) -> GET /api/admin/removal-requests 200 -> PUT .../honour 200 -> queue empty, operator NOT signed out. DB confirms: status=excluded, excluded_at set, exclusion_email retained, third_spaces.opted_out=true. All four admin pages load with real data (5/21/68 rows + queue). FOUR bugs found by driving, three mine: (1) invented status literal so Approve/Reject never rendered; (2) enrolment dead end; (3) admin 401 signed the operator out of the whole app; (4) init repointed but update not, so actions 401'd. 1285 elm tests passed through all four.
G6.last_action: Everything DRIVEN and proven (see #303 DoD, 5 of 6 boxes checked with evidence). ONE box open and it is real work, not paperwork: an E2E spec that reaches an admin page with a real MFA-verified session. Needs TOTP in TypeScript + the enrolment flow, because a preview redeploy destroys MFA enrolment every time.
